about: L4 terrain fixtures and goldens (the test strategy, sections 3.1 and 3.3). Rendered by the exported viewer's --test-render at 640x360, fixed camera (Stage.Overview), fixed environment and light, no MSAA/TAA/FXAA, from the core's TerrainStore. Goldens are proposed by the render script and approved by a person after viewing; nothing re-baselines on its own.

tolerance.meaning: a pixel differs when any RGB channel is more than 16/255 from the golden; the image passes when at most 0.2 % of pixels differ and the mean absolute channel error is at most 0.5/255

synthetic-512x256.provenance: generated by Viewer.Shell.SyntheticTerrain.Make("synthetic-512x256", 512, 256) (deterministic formula; RenderFixtureTests checks the file against it)
synthetic-512x256.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
synthetic-512x256.region: 512 x 256 m var region, 16 m patches (32 x 16 = 512 patches)
synthetic-512x256.simulator: none (fed into WorldState as LandPatch-shaped patches)
synthetic-512x256.camera: Stage.Overview: fov 60, from the south-west above the centre
synthetic-512x256.environment: background colour, colour ambient 0.6, one directional light (-50, -35, 0) energy 1.1, linear tonemap, no shadows, glow, SSAO, SSR, SDFGI or fog
synthetic-512x256.cache_state: no caches (shader cache and pipeline cache off in project.godot)

local_only.region-b: fixtures-local\goldens\golden-region-b-terrain-<backend>.png from fixtures-local\capture-region-b.jsonl.gz replayed into the core (1024x1024); never committed (grid content, ADR-011); the render stage skips with a reason when the capture is absent
